intent: Selectable cards for a plan or option picker. Single or multi select, with title, description, and a price or meta slot.
useWhen: Choosing a plan, tier, or option where title, description, and price should be compared
A short set of cards, one selected or several
doNotUseWhen: Short labels with no description — use SegmentedControl
A plain radio list — use RadioGroup
Independent settings that take effect immediately — use Switch
A framed content tile that is not a choice — use Card

items.note: meta is the price or other short slot at the end of the title row.

value.note: controlled. string when selection is single, string[] when multiple.

onChange.note: (value: string) => void for single, (value: string[]) => void for multiple

disabled.note: Locks the whole group. A disabled item stays visible and cannot be checked.

requirements: selection=single is a radiogroup of radio buttons; arrows move the checked tile
selection=multiple is a group of checkbox buttons; arrows move focus and Space toggles
Disabled tiles stay in the group and cannot be checked

doNot: Do not invent Tile, TileGroupItem, or PlanPicker cousins
Do not use RadioGroup layout=card when the option needs a price slot
Do not ship the group without ariaLabel
snippet: <TileGroup ariaLabel="Plan" defaultValue="pro" items={[{ value: 'starter', title: 'Starter', description: 'For drafts', meta: '$12' }, { value: 'pro', title: 'Pro', description: 'For teams', meta: '$29' }]} />
